title: Jessy Pouliot
subtitle: Senior Software Engineer
presentation: Full-stack engineer with strong expertise in TypeScript, React, React Native, and modern backend tooling. Over six years designing and delivering performant applications, scalable APIs, and developer-focused infrastructure. Adept at turning complex product requirements into clean, maintainable systems while improving engineering processes and cross-team collaboration. Known for high-quality execution, pragmatic decision-making, and a deep understanding of frontend and mobile architecture.

Graphic design fundamentals and UI/UX principles

content.text: Led a significant rewrite of the account transactions experience, modernizing the architecture to reduce clutter, improve performance, and ensure long-term maintainability.
Improved responsiveness by over 600% by identifying and correcting rendering inefficiencies in the account transactions implementation.
Designed and implemented a highly customizable local API-mocking system, enabling developers to simulate complex account scenarios and dramatically improving development speed and testability.

Performed cross-team code reviews, identified deep architectural issues, and advised on performance, type safety, and best practices. Becoming an informal technical resource for developers outside the immediate team.
Designed and built advanced interfaces, including a user-customizable layout system using CSS grid template areas and drag-and-drop configuration.
Implemented an infinite-scroll timeline component with efficient virtualization techniques, enabling smooth performance at scale.
Developed high-performance backend features using PostgreSQL, Redis, TRPC, and react-query.
Built a React Native mobile application from the ground up with near feature parity to the web platform.
Established monorepo tooling to unify shared code across platforms, introduce task caching, and streamline CI/CD pipelines. Significantly reducing build time and operational costs.
Collaborated closely with design and product to deliver refined and resilient features across mobile and web.
Built foundational components for the mobile application, improving development speed and consistency across teams.
Served as a primary resource for diagnosing and resolving complex mobile issues, regularly identifying root causes in legacy code.
Won the 2021 internal hackathon by implementing a CMS-based solution with JSON caching on a CDN, reducing copy-update turnaround from weeks to minutes.
